name: Morriga
bio: Under dark canopies, within vine-tangled forests circling mountains north of the Emerald Kingdom, live Eldrin who find comfort in shadow. Morriga is one such Eldrin, and while she may dwell in darkness, she is no ally to Malice. Through her dagger's eerie light, Morriga can contort shadows to her will – perfect for striking Darkborn when they least expect it.
